/.title: Harbor Museum visitor guide
paragraphs: This is a synthetic visitor guide. Read the linked pages to plan a visit.
The guide has opening hours, group visit rules and accessibility information.

/hours.title: Opening hours
paragraphs: The museum opens Tuesday through Sunday from 10:00 to 17:00. It is closed on Monday.
Last entry is at 16:00. Quiet hour is Wednesday from 10:00 to 11:00.

/groups.title: Groups and accessibility
paragraphs: Groups of 12 or more visitors need a reservation. This guide cannot create reservations.
The accessible entrance is in the East Courtyard. Wheelchairs can be borrowed at the visitor desk.
